scope: Four fixed supported proposals chosen by the preregistered public-role contrast and legal prior, before any continuation outcomes. Four independent terrains, one pair per terrain, eight total arms; up to two distinct single cores concurrently; natural argmax pilot archived as a diagnostic only.
historical_prefix: Replay signed action history into the official engine from t=0 on the approved training terrain. Update Master3s2 BeliefTracker using the original-side public observation and actual historical commands for that side. Verify the current packs reproduce their complete surveyed public commands. Prior historical moves may belong to other policies; we cannot reconstruct their private RNG, wall cost, or claim a full current-agent match.
root: Natural fresh original-policy RNG (seed=None), freshly warmed native cost and statistics; transfer only the public posterior and previous players into that original's private state. Call its full public entry exactly once before either own arm takes effect. Snapshot tracker, RNG and costs after the root call. Both arms must start from independent restores of that exact snapshot; no hidden foreign actions, final scores, abbreviated search or callback injection.
suffix: Use each entire candidate joint action once, shared pre-action opponent move once. From the next step onward both own arms use 8da4 and the original independently responds with its natural T1, .58s policy. Rebuild stateful parent features by replaying each public observation and progressing the official environment using signed prefix commands. Save official terminal scores, costs by side, every joint order and native-clock receipts; alternate branch order by registered pilot index, keep no-effect and unfavorable outcomes.
archived_vs_new_root: active_roots records an archived enemy root order as part of its action-only preflight. The collector explicitly generates one new natural original enemy root order after rebuilding the historical posterior, records both separately, and shares the new order across the pair. Fresh native search adaptation and natural RNG start from the reconstructed public history, not from unknowable historical private runtime or random state.
